description: Pin receipt emitted by ipfs-pinner after one of mst-projector's shard CAR files has been pinned to ≥1 IPFS providers (Kubo / Pinata / Web3.Storage / Filecoin via Storacha). Per ADR-2605171800 Stage 4. Readers can resolve the pinned CAR by `carCid` from any IPFS gateway and reconstruct the projected MST shard. The original snapshot record (`com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot`) carries the MST `rootCid` that this pin's CAR contains as its single root.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this pin covers, copied from the originating shardSnapshot. e.g. `com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.post`.

rootCid.description: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor) of the shard at the time of CAR flush. Matches the `rootCid` field of the originating `com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot` record.

carCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the CAR file itself, returned by the pin provider. Identical across providers for a given CAR (deterministic content addressing).

snapshotUri.description: AT URI of the originating `com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot` record, when known. Optional in Phase 1 emissions where the pinner subscribes to local CAR files directly rather than via firehose.

providers.description: Names of pin providers that confirmed the pin. Constitutional minimum at production = 2 distinct providers (per README replication factor); single-provider emissions are allowed only when ETZ_PINNER_PROVIDERS = single name and the operator explicitly opted out of redundancy.

byteSize.description: Size of the CAR file in bytes.

blockCount.description: Number of dag-cbor blocks in the CAR (root + unstored MST blocks).
